tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground for every screen. Warm off-white; never swap for pure white.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: All text, the wordmark, rules and filled buttons. Reads 12.5:1 on `cream` and 10.5:1 on `stone`.

tokens.name: navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: captions, card metadata, the (1). numerals. 6.1:1 on `cream`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and the wordmark when they sit on `navy`, `charcoal` or full-bleed photography. 12.8:1 on `navy` and 14.6:1 on `charcoal`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: The one dark section (footer and booking band). Pair with `white` text.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Studio-wall grey from the photography backdrops. Image placeholders and quiet panels; never a text colour.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Skin-tone warmth sampled from the campaign photography. Decorative fills and image placeholders only; 2.7:1 on `cream`, so never text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between treatment rows and around inputs on `cream`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements over photography and section openers.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines and the long intro paragraph.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy. Keep to 60–70 characters a line.
styles.sample: More than a treatment, Odyssée is a restoration.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase nav, buttons and eyebrows. Always `text-transform: uppercase`.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its body line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of buttons (vertical ×0.75) and nav gutters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side margin on mobile; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop; space between stacked sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of full sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every surface, image and button. The site uses no rounded corners.
